name: cj5n05-spoke-health-fallback
goal: A spoke that cannot reach the hub sends its health alert on the backup channel

evidence: A spoke with the hub down fails only hub_link; its local API queues the health ask, so no fallback is posted. Expected: the fallback is posted after quiet hours.
tracker-health-fallback.test.ts only ran hub nodes; added the unlinked-spoke fixture and scenario there.
